method: Purposive search of public Upwork job URLs and official product/platform documentation. This is not a representative sample of all jobs or awarded contracts.
access_limit: Direct Upwork job pages returned access errors. Job details below were readable in search-index snapshots of those same original URLs. Open status, current proposal counts and actual agreed prices are unverified. Relative 'hours ago' labels refer to crawl context, not today's time.

jobs.title: Shopify Bulk Product Import – ~3,000 Products from Supplier Catalogs
jobs.indexed_budget: $12–27/hour in page fields; body asks for a fixed quote
jobs.scope: 8 supplier catalogs, around 3,000 products, normalization, variant/image mapping, import and verification; paid trial around 50 products
jobs.constraints: Prior large Shopify/Matrixify imports and basic French reading
jobs.interpretation: Strong evidence of the workflow, but most scope is outside a small file checker. Conflicting budget formats need client clarification.

jobs.title: WooCommerce + WPML Specialist - New Product Upload & Multi-Language Translation
jobs.scope: Supplier CSV vs store comparison using SKU and EAN; two stores, six languages, upload, WPML links and mandatory report
jobs.constraints: Explicitly not beginner work; proven WooCommerce and WPML experience
jobs.interpretation: Conflict reporting is valuable, but the full contract requires platform and translation integration.

jobs.title: Shopify Products and Price Updates Assistant
jobs.scope: Recurring furniture supplier sheets, field mapping, prices, costs, complex variants and bulk updates; some months 10–20 hours
jobs.constraints: Body requests Philippines remote, despite page displaying Worldwide; expert Shopify and spreadsheet skills
jobs.interpretation: Repeat work exists, but low advertised rates and location requirements limit relevance.

platform_costs.facts: Connects cost USD 0.15 each. Required Connects vary by job and can change. Rejection, another freelancer being selected, and expiry without hire do not return Connects.
Freelancer service fee ranges from 0% to 15% per contract and is shown before proposal/offer acceptance.

alternatives.facts: Built-in importer automatically maps recognized columns; supplier CSV preparation and variation structure require care.
Matrixify advertises import/export/update features, free demo and Basic at USD 20/month.
Vendor advertises AI column-mapping suggestions, human confirmation, reusable mappings and validation. This is a feature claim, not independent evidence of sales or performance.

analysis.recommendation: Build a narrow supplier-file mapping and catalog preflight workflow as a contest project and freelance delivery aid. Validate paid demand before building a hosted subscription product.
analysis.initial_scope: One CSV, one currency, one target template, simple products; preserve original values, confirm ambiguous mappings, emit a standardized file plus row-level issues and change log.
analysis.ai_role: Use an open-weight model to infer nonstandard/multilingual column semantics from headers and a few example values. Deterministic code checks missing values, identifiers and conflicts. Do not let the model invent prices, identifiers or exchange rates.
analysis.sample_gaps: Downloaded fixtures use platform-native headers; none contains duplicate nonempty exact SKUs. Heterogeneous supplier headers and duplicate/conflict cases still need independently labeled fixtures. CrossPeak bad names/SKUs contain issue labels and cannot support a fair model benchmark without addressing leakage.

estimates_not_market_statistics.cash_build_budget_usd: 0–30 incremental, assuming suitable existing hardware or an inexpensive external inference arrangement; not yet benchmarked
estimates_not_market_statistics.initial_outreach_budget_usd: 30–50 proposed cap; no proposals sent or purchases made
estimates_not_market_statistics.scenario: 20 proposals × assumed 16 Connects × USD 0.15 = USD 48. One hypothetical USD 80 contract at a 15% service fee leaves USD 20 after those proposal costs, before tax, withdrawal, compute and labor. This is an illustration, not an estimated conversion rate.
